pages.title: Press the Oil First
pages.text: Deep-frying needs $(thing)vegetable oil$(), and the oil is pressed in a $(thing)Wooden Basin$():$(br2)The basin has five slots:$(li)raw ingredient (oilseed) slot$(li)filter slot$(li)waste slot$(li)bottle-filling slot$(li)bottle output slot$(br2)Load the ingredient and the filter, then $(thing)stand on the basin and jump$() to press once: it consumes 1 ingredient and 1 point of filter durability.

pages.title: Press the Oil First
pages.text: Vegetable oil comes out at about 111 mB per press, so three presses (≈333 mB) fill one $(thing)bottle of vegetable oil$(); the basin holds up to 1 000 mB, enough to fill a bucket directly.$(br2)The basin also presses $(thing)water, sugar water, soy milk$() and more: soy milk comes from pressing soybeans, sugar water from apples, beetroot, cactus, melon slices, sugar cane, berries and the like.$(br2)Pressing $(thing)magma blocks$() gives lava and hurts you, setting you on fire.$(br2)After pressing, put an empty bottle or bucket in the filling slot to draw the liquid out.

pages.title: Deep Fryer
pages.text: The deep fryer has $(thing)four slots$() and holds $(thing)1 000 mB of oil$(); each finished portion uses $(thing)50 mB$() and takes $(thing)15 seconds$().$(br2)Oiling: right-click the $(thing)top$() with a $(thing)bottle of vegetable oil$() or a $(thing)bucket of oil$().$(br)Fuel: put a $(thing)Gas Canister$() in $(thing)the block behind$() the fryer with its front facing the fryer — a gas cooking stove does nothing here.

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: $(li)Right-click $(thing)the top$(): add or remove ingredients / add oil$(li)Right-click $(thing)the front$(): start or stop frying$(li)Right-click any other face, or sneak and right-click: open the interface$(li)Crowbar right-click: rotate$(br2)While running it burns gas at 6.67 mB/s, so a full 6 000 mB canister lasts about 15 minutes.$(br2)The interface shows the progress of all four slots and the oil level. But you cannot reach in directly.

pages.title: Deep Fry Basket
pages.text: The $(thing)Deep Fry Basket$() holds four items at once. Breaking it does not spill the contents — they are stored in the item, making it a small shulker box of sorts.

pages.title: Tongs
pages.text: $(br2)$(thing)Tongs$() are the only safe way to take food out: reaching into a working fryer with your bare hands $(thing)burns$() you, while putting the tongs in the oil first makes it harmless.
